summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the standard way for AI agents to connect to external tools, data, and APIs through a uniform interface, replacing bespoke integrations with a shared protocol. By late 2026 the ecosystem spans hosted remote servers (now OAuth-secured and the default for major vendors like GitHub, Vercel, and Linear), aggregator marketplaces that bundle thousands of servers, and gateways that handle auth, routing, and observability. This matters because MCP lets a single agent securely orchestrate dozens of services—browsers, repos, databases, design tools—without custom glue code.
ecosystem_note: Individual MCP servers expose one service's tools (e.g., GitHub or Playwright), aggregators are marketplaces/SDKs that let you discover and install many servers at once (Composio, Smithery, mcp.so), and gateways/proxies sit in front of servers to add auth, routing, rate-limiting, and observability (Cloudflare MCP, Kong, agentgateway).

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions, code search, and now an OAuth-secured hosted remote endpoint for agent-driven repo automation
tools.pricing_paid: Free for the server; usage governed by existing GitHub plan tiers (Free/Team/Enterprise)
strengths: Official first-party server with OAuth-secured remote endpoint
Deepest adoption across Cursor, Claude, and VS Code agents
Automates full repo, PR, and CI workflows
tools.best_for: Agents that read, write, and automate code and CI/CD across GitHub repositories

tools.name: Playwright MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Browser automation—navigation, clicks, form fills, scraping, and end-to-end testing via accessibility tree
strengths: Industry-standard browser control for agents
Deterministic accessibility-tree approach instead of pixel guessing
Huge GitHub star count and install base in Cursor/Claude
tools.best_for: Agents that need to browse, scrape, or run automated web/mobile testing

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 250+ managed app integrations (Gmail, Slack, Jira, Notion, Salesforce, etc.) with built-in auth, exposed as MCP tools
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based paid tiers; team/enterprise plans with SSO and higher action limits
strengths: Managed OAuth/auth for hundreds of apps
Strong developer docs and SDKs
Reduces per-service integration maintenance
tools.best_for: Teams that want one platform to give agents authenticated access to many SaaS tools

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP Server / Remote MCP
tools.connects_to: Hosting and routing remote MCP servers with OAuth, Workers, Durable Objects, and edge observability
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans (usage-based) for higher limits and production workloads
strengths: First-class remote MCP hosting with built-in OAuth
Global edge performance
Easy deploy of custom servers via Workers
tools.best_for: Deploying and gating remote MCP servers at scale with authentication

tools.name: Figma MCP Server (Dev Mode)
tools.connects_to: Design files, components, and Dev Mode context so agents can turn designs into code
tools.pricing_paid: Requires Figma paid seats (Dev/Full seats on Professional, Organization, Enterprise plans)
strengths: Official OAuth-secured hosted endpoint
Design-to-code workflows for agents
Tight integration with Cursor and VS Code
tools.best_for: Agents generating front-end code directly from Figma designs

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Registry/marketplace of thousands of MCP servers with one-click discovery, deployment, and hosting
tools.pricing_paid: Paid hosting/usage tiers for deployed servers
strengths: Largest community MCP registry
One-click install and remote hosting
Strong discovery for clients like Cursor and Claude
tools.best_for: Discovering, installing, and hosting MCP servers quickly

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Postgres databases, table queries, schema management, auth, and edge functions via OAuth-secured endpoint
tools.pricing_paid: Supabase Pro/Team/Enterprise plans for production database usage
strengths: Official hosted remote endpoint
Lets agents query and manage real databases safely
Popular in full-stack agent workflows
tools.best_for: Agents that read/write application databases and manage backend infra

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Notion pages, databases, and docs for reading, searching, and writing knowledge-base content
tools.pricing_paid: Requires Notion paid plans for team/enterprise workspaces
strengths: Official OAuth-secured hosted endpoint
Ideal for knowledge retrieval and doc automation
Widely adopted for agent memory/knowledge use cases
tools.best_for: Agents that manage docs, wikis, and structured knowledge in Notion

tools.name: mcp.so
tools.connects_to: Directory of thousands of MCP servers and clients for browsing, comparison, and discovery
strengths: Comprehensive community catalog
High search/discovery traffic
Vendor-neutral browsing of the ecosystem
tools.best_for: Browsing and comparing the full catalog of available MCP servers

tools.name: Stripe MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Payments, customers, invoices, subscriptions, and billing operations via OAuth-secured endpoint
tools.pricing_paid: Free server; standard Stripe transaction fees apply
strengths: Official hosted endpoint for payment workflows
Lets agents query and manage billing safely
Strong docs and developer trust
tools.best_for: Agents handling payments, billing, and financial operations

tools.name: Docker MCP Catalog & Toolkit
tools.connects_to: Containerized MCP servers run and managed via Docker Desktop, with the MCP Catalog as a trusted registry and gateway
tools.pricing_paid: Docker Business/Team subscriptions for org-scale management
strengths: Secure, sandboxed server execution in containers
Trusted catalog of verified MCP images
Simplifies local setup and gating of servers
tools.best_for: Running and isolating many MCP servers securely via containers

tools.name: Sentry MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Error tracking, performance data, issues, and release monitoring for agent-driven debugging
tools.pricing_paid: Sentry Team/Business paid plans for higher event volumes
strengths: Official remote MCP endpoint
Lets agents triage and debug production errors
Strong adoption in developer debugging workflows
tools.best_for: Agents that investigate and resolve production errors and performance issues
